name: Route 110
lines:
The door is locked.
A message is written on the scroll on the door:
“Write the secret code here.”
A secret code is written on it.

CLICKETY-CLACK...
MECHADOLL 1 AM I!
IF YOU ANSWER QUIZZES FROM ALL
FIVE MECHADOLLS CORRECTLY,
YOU CAN OBTAIN THE SECRET CODE.

MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ
One of these Pokémon is not found
on Route 103. Which one is it?

MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ
One of these Pokémon is not of the
Grass type. Which one is it?

MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ
One of these Pokémon uses Scratch.
Which one is it?

CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.
GO THROUGH, PLEASE.
YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE WE WAIT FOR.

CLICKETY-CLACK...
MECHADOLL 2 AM I!
MECHADOLL 1’S QUIZ DIFFICULTY LEVEL
IS SET TOO LOW.

MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ
In Professor Birch’s Bag, there were three
Pokémon. Which one was at the right?

MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ
Which Pokémon was offered for a trade
at the Pokémon Trainers’ School?

MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ
What Pokémon was the Devon researcher
looking for in Petalburg Woods?

CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.
GO THROUGH, PLEASE.

CLICKETY-CLACK...
MECHADOLL 3 AM I!
MATTERS OF MONEY ARE MY SOLE FOCUS.

MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ
Which costs more?
Three Poké Balls or one Super Potion?

MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ
Sell one Escape Rope and buy
one Antidote. How much money remains?

MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ
Which would cost more, a Full Heal plus a Great Ball,
or one Revive?

CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.
THIS IS A PRIZE.

CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.
GO THROUGH, PLEASE.

CLICKETY-CLACK...
MECHADOLL 4, THAT IS ME!
MY QUIZ IS AN OBJECT OF BEAUTY.

MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ
Rustboro Gym Leader Roxanne used a
Geodude. Was it female or male?

MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ
In Dewford Hall, were there more men
or women?

MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ
Was the first Trainer in Dewford Gym
male or female?

CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.
GO THROUGH, PLEASE.

CLICKETY-CLACK...
MECHADOLL 5 AM I!
THE MASTER’S BEST AND PROUDEST
ACHIEVEMENT AM I.

MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ
How many Bikes does Rydel have on
display outside his cycle shop?

MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ
How many people give you Berries at the
Pretty Petal flower shop?

MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ
How many signs are there in
Lilycove City?

CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.
GO THROUGH, PLEASE.
